text: Leh is a high-altitude desert town in Ladakh, with Buddhist monasteries, stupas, an old town and a bazaar. The Incredible India guide describes Ladakh as a high-altitude desert region.
The Leh guide highlights Shanti Stupa, Leh Palace, the Old Town and monasteries in the surrounding Ladakh region.
Leh is served by Kushok Bakula Rimpochee Airport (IXL). Incredible India lists Jammu Tawi Railway Station (JAT) as a rail link for reaching the region.
Incredible India describes February to October as the ideal period for visiting Leh. Conditions can vary substantially by season at this high altitude.
General India travel guidance: respect local dress codes and customs, particularly at religious sites and in rural areas.
General India travel guidance warns that scammers, pickpockets and ticket touts target visitors in tourist areas. Check ticket sellers and agents before paying.
General India travel advice recommends following local authority guidance, keeping belongings secure on public transport and in crowds, and using emergency number 112 when needed.
